headline: JSA acts on Two Point O Capital Series A fundraise
sum: Two Point O Capital has raised $10 million from a Series A fundraise led by Transition Venture Capital Fund I, with participation from existing investor Omnivore Agritech & Climate Sustainability Fund 3, among others. JSA Advocates and…
detail: Two Point O Capital has raised $10 million from a Series A fundraise led by Transition Venture Capital Fund I, with participation from existing investor Omnivore Agritech & Climate Sustainability Fund 3, among others. JSA Advocates and Solicitors advised Two Point O Capital on this fundraise. The transaction was led by Nidhi Khadria (Partner), with support from Alby Joseph (Principal Associate) and Kishan B Nair (Junior Associate).
